title: LeetCode Test Case
description: A plain test case, or with "kind": "classDesign" a class design test case.

kind.description: Absent for a plain test case.

timeoutInMilliseconds.description: Budget for the test case in milliseconds: CPU time spent by a C# solution, less JIT compilation; wall-clock time for a SQL or Bash one.

commands.description: Method names to invoke. The first element is the constructor.

output.description: Expected return values for each method call.
